title: The Chromosome That Left a Trace — Nowell–Hungerford & Rowley Philadelphia Translocation, Druker STI571 & Inactive ABL1 Pose (PDB 2HYY), IRIS International-Scale BCR::ABL1 RT-qPCR Monitoring & the T315I Gatekeeper Switch

teenKit.tldr: In 15 seconds: A swapped piece of chromosome 9 and 22 created the BCR::ABL1 cancer kinase; imatinib locked its inactive fold (PDB 2HYY), RT-qPCR tracked leukemia down by 10,000-fold in blood, and a single T315I atom clash forced next-generation molecular redesign.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Chronic myeloid leukemia transformed cancer medicine from fatal bone-marrow failure into a chronic condition managed by pairing structural drug design with ultra-sensitive molecular blood tests.
keyTakeaways: Nowell, Hungerford, and Janet Rowley traced the Philadelphia chromosome to the t(9;22) translocation fusing BCR to ABL1 into a constitutively active tyrosine kinase.
Imatinib (STI571) captures the DFG-out inactive conformation of ABL1 (PDB 2HYY), relying on a critical hydrogen bond to the Thr315 'gatekeeper' hydroxyl.
When BCR::ABL1 transcripts rise on the International Scale (IS) RT-qPCR log curve, kinase-domain sequencing can reveal the T315I mutation—which deletes that H-bond and sterically blocks imatinib.

vocab.meaning: Shortened chromosome 22 resulting from t(9;22)(q34;q11), encoding the oncogenic BCR::ABL1 fusion kinase.
An inactive kinase state where the Asp-Phe-Gly motif flips outward, opening an allosteric pocket bound by Type II inhibitors like imatinib.
Substitution of threonine 315 with bulkier isoleucine in ABL1, abolishing imatinib's key hydrogen bond and sterically clashing with first/second-generation TKIs.

quiz.question: Why does the ABL1 T315I mutation cause complete resistance to imatinib in PDB 2HYY?
options: Isoleucine removes the Thr315 hydroxyl hydrogen bond and introduces a bulky methyl/ethyl clash in the ATP/allosteric channel
quiz.explanation: Thr315 donates/accepts a crucial hydrogen bond and guards pocket entry; mutating it to Ile315 both breaks the H-bond and creates a steric wall.
